agent_directives.objective: Execute tasks in priority order; after each task, run its verify commands.
agent_directives.loop: audit -> fix -> re-verify -> next task; stop when all gates pass.
agent_directives.report_format: per-task: id, status(pass/fail), verify output summary; final: gate results
agent_directives.escalate_when: a verify command fails 5 times, or a task requires a forbidden operation
